findings.title: Optional auditRoles rejected a valid audit-disabled policy preview
findings.evidence: Backend policy description includes auditRoles only when audit is enabled. Reviewed client allows auditRoles in the closed field set but does not require it; when supplied it validates the closed role shape. New native-runtime-client.test.mjs source fixture covers the prior-field disabled shape, missing legacy fields, extras, malformed auditRoles, and no confirmation/grant/create/execute calls.

findings.title: Audit request cleanup skipped after task revision
findings.evidence: Reviewed createAuditModel refresh and run cleanup use connection epoch rather than local task revision, preserving stale-result suppression while clearing busy after task-revision drift. New source fixtures cover delayed refresh, delayed configure after auth drift, and old-connection cleanup preserving a new connection's busy state.

findings.title: Stale audit mutations/previews and query identity were not fenced separately
findings.evidence: Approved client gates ordinary operations while audit state is stale, permits same-task query, preserves stale/uncertain state on query, compares returned worker identity fields against the retained mapping, and gives the card a separate current-task query gate. New fixtures cover drift, safe query, changed task, late response after auth drift, and foreign action/action-digest/claim/reservation/generation/session identities.

findings.title: Uncertain audit create cannot reach its safe query path
findings.evidence: On lost dispatchAudit response, run records uncertain='dispatchAudit' and refreshes taskModel, but does not project a newly observed worker into audit model state. create remains fenced by uncertainty, while query and its button require state.worker. The current task snapshot may contain the created worker, but audit model does not derive the exact mapping. Thus the safe query path handles uncertain execute when worker is known, but not uncertain create. Host authority remains a final fence.
findings.recommended_semantics: Project a unique current selected-task worker only when actionRef and actionDigest match the privately planned audit action; do not resend dispatch; refuse ambiguous/foreign mappings.
findings.recommended_fixture: Lose dispatchAudit response after commit, refresh task facts, verify no second dispatch, project/query only a unique matching worker, preserve uncertainty until factual query reconciliation, and refuse ambiguous or foreign candidates.

findings.title: Documented midstream-revocation cleanup boundary
findings.evidence: Updated native-runtime-source.test.mjs covers lazy pulls across await, authorized awaited return, revocation before first pull, and revocation after yield before consumer return. The last case asserts the revoked callback is refused before producer finalizer and explicitly makes no cleanup claim. This is fail-closed for callback authority and matches no-instant-cancellation scope, but does not prove producer resource termination or reservation release; these remain factual host lifecycle matters.
